name: José Cubas
title: GM
subject: AI Chess Coach for Societal Good
body:
Dear GM Cubas Sir,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. GM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. GM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. GM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. IM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. IM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. IM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. IM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

body:
Dear WFM Perez Ma'am,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. WFM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

subject: AI Chess Coach for Societal Good
body:
Dear FM Rastbod Sir,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. FM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

subject: AI Chess Coach for Societal Good
body:
Dear CM Swain Sir,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. CM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

Dear WFM Montejo Ma'am,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. WFM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

Dear FM Darmin Sir,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. FM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. FM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. NM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. FM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

Dear FM Rubery Sir,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. FM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. FM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. FM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. WIM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. FM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. WIM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

subject: AI Chess Coach for Societal Good
body:
Dear CM Melaugh Sir,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. CM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria

Dear WGM Dornbusch Ma'am,

My name is Aayan Hetamsaria. I am a 16 year old in Seattle who grew up in Mumbai. I saw first-hand the half-naked children and frail women sleeping on the streets.

Today, chess coaching has become overly expensive, with some coaches charging over $200/hour. I built a free AI chess coach called Chess Masti to help give these children that do not have that kind of money a powerful resource to learn, train and play chess. We directly raise money for the Akanksha Education Fund, a 501(c)(3) that funds such schools for under-resourced kids in Mumbai and Pune.

I would be permanently indebted to you if you could try out the AI for 15 minutes and give me some feedback. WGM testimonials like yours can help grow this product's impact exponentially.

The site is chessmasti.com

Thank you so much for your time and attention. If you are willing to give me a quick line about why you like the product, that would be deeply appreciated.

Thank you so much!

Sincerely,
Aayan Hetamsaria
